About the Project

IMPRS Cognitive NeuroImaging in Leipzig supports doctoral research into the brain and cognition. Candidates apply through the programme's selection process and arrange references separately, with the chosen research group determining the scientific project.

Research Areas

  • Neuroscience
  • Cognitive science
  • Neuroimaging

Funding and duration

ComponentDetails
Award or positionPhD scholarship / studentship
Stipend / salaryThree-year employment contract at 65% TVöD E13; any extension requires a separate agreement.

Eligibility and Requirements

CriterionRequirement
Applicant eligibilityProgramme and project criteria apply; see official eligibility guidance
Further conditionsReferences due 10 November; neuroscience-related qualifications.

Application dates

ComponentDetails
Recruitment statusOpen
Deadline / consideration round2 November 2026, 23:59 CET
LocationGermany

About Max Planck Society

The Max Planck Society operates research institutes and International Max Planck Research Schools in Germany. Doctoral candidates work within a selected institute or partner university, with funding and supervision arranged through the programme or project.

Official details: Read the programme or project information

Application route: Follow the official application instructions

2026 TV-L E13 scale (verified): €4,759.37–€6,764.69 gross per month full-time, effective 1 April 2026; part-time positions are pro-rated.

How to Apply

Submit your application through the official portal before the deadline: 2 November 2026, 23:59 CET. Read the eligibility requirements carefully and prepare all requested documents — early applications are strongly recommended for competitive awards.
